name: ioopenuiao

scripts.build: npm run build:root && npm run build:realtime && npm run build:chat
scripts.build:root: vite build && rm -rf public/assets public/index.html && cp -r dist/assets public/assets && cp dist/index.html public/index.html
scripts.build:realtime: cd put-a-realtime-webrtc/web && npm ci && npm run build
scripts.build:chat: cd put-b-chat-socketio/web && npm ci && npm run build

description: IO-OPENUI-AO — Platforma za profesionalnu saradnju i real-time komunikaciju. Powered by WebRTC + Socket.IO.
